categories.main_business_segments: Chemed Corporation operates two primary business segments: VITAS, which provides hospice and palliative care services, and Roto-Rooter, which offers plumbing, drain cleaning, excavation, water restoration, and related services. Each segment is managed independently and serves distinct markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: VITAS delivers hospice care through an interdisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, leveraging proprietary training materials, software, and compliance processes to meet regulatory standards. Roto-Rooter utilizes specialized plumbing and drain cleaning equipment, proprietary service protocols, and a recognized brand, supported by a network of company-owned branches, independent contractors, and franchisees.
categories.primary_customers_markets: VITAS primarily serves terminally ill patients, with over 90% of revenue coming from Medicare and Medicaid, and the remainder from commercial insurers and private pay. Roto-Rooter serves a broad base of residential and commercial customers needing plumbing, drain cleaning, and water restoration services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Chemed’s operations are concentrated in the United States. VITAS operates in 16 states and the District of Columbia, with a significant presence in Florida. Roto-Rooter has company-owned and franchised operations in 34 states, covering over 90% of the U.S. population.
categories.supply_chain_position: VITAS operates downstream, directly providing end-of-life healthcare services to patients. Roto-Rooter is also downstream, delivering plumbing and related services directly to end customers, supported by a supply chain for equipment, pharmaceuticals, and medical supplies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Chemed’s strategic focus includes expanding its hospice and plumbing service footprints through organic growth and selective acquisitions, maintaining regulatory compliance, and investing in workforce training and technology. Innovation is centered on service delivery improvements, operational efficiency, and adapting to regulatory and labor market changes, rather than material R&D expenditures.
categories.revenue_model: VITAS generates revenue primarily through per diem payments from Medicare and Medicaid for hospice services, supplemented by commercial insurance and private pay. Roto-Rooter earns revenue from direct service fees paid by residential and commercial customers, as well as franchise and independent contractor fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: VITAS is one of the largest for-profit hospice providers in a highly fragmented industry dominated by small, community-based and not-for-profit hospices, as well as competition from hospitals and home health agencies. Roto-Rooter is the largest provider of plumbing and drain cleaning services in the U.S., competing mainly with local and regional firms in a fragmented market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Chemed reported $2.13 billion in consolidated revenue and $249.6 million in net income. Roto-Rooter accounted for 44% of revenue and VITAS for 56%. The company has demonstrated stable profitability, with modest revenue growth at Roto-Rooter and a recent decline at VITAS due to labor shortages and regulatory headwinds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: VITAS differentiates itself through its scale, ability to deliver high-quality, responsive hospice care, and compliance with stringent Medicare requirements. Roto-Rooter leverages its nationally recognized brand, comprehensive service offerings, emergency availability, and reputation for quality and reliability to stand out in a fragmented market.
